title: A MettleUp message to every gym never reaches staff whose admin app is closed
what: When MettleUp sends a message to every gym, it only waits in the admin app's bell. The browser alerts that reach staff with the admin app closed carry only news from members, so an owner who rarely opens the admin app never hears of a MettleUp message (a price change, a planned outage) until he next opens it.
expected: A message from MettleUp also reaches the gym's switched-on browser alerts, at least for the owner, following the gym's chosen instant, daily or weekly setting.
fix_line: Also turn each MettleUp message into a browser alert for each gym's owner

title: While MettleUp has paused a gym, its door machine's entries are thrown away for good
what: When MettleUp pauses a gym, its door machine is treated as paused too. Every upload from the machine is then answered as received but not saved, so the machine deletes its stored entries. Members still walk in, but after the pause ends those visits are missing for good. For an unknown machine the same code answers 'not received' so the machine keeps its entries; the pause does not. Not live yet: the door-machine link is not deployed.
expected: During a pause the machine is told to keep its entries, and they are saved once the gym is active again.
who: gym owners with a door machine
fix_line: Answer a paused gym's machine uploads with 'not received' so the machine keeps them

title: The planned plan-end reminders leave out gyms whose free trial is ending
what: The nightly job lists gyms 7, 3 and 1 days before their plan ends, for the reminder message. It reads only paid monthly and yearly plans, never the free-trial end date, so a gym coming to the end of its trial, the moment it most needs a nudge to pay, is never on the list. The message itself is not built yet, so nothing is lost today.
expected: Gyms whose free trial ends in 7, 3 or 1 days are on the same reminder list.
how_often: every trial end, once messages are built
fix_line: Add trial-ending gyms to the nightly reminder list
